reason: README clearly shows this plugin’s primary purpose is to orchestrate multi-agent collaboration in DeepSeek Harness sessions by turning user instructions into team workflows with task partitioning, role-based delegation, and visible team activity in the web interface.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过自然语言触发并驱动多智能体团队协作，支持任务拆分与分派，并在 Web 界面右上角展示团队活动面板。
summaries.en: This plugin enables users to launch and run a multi-agent team in DeepSeek Harness with natural language, while displaying team activity in the web interface.

capabilities: Coordinates multiple agents in a workflow to execute a user task.
Supports task decomposition, dependency declaration, and team member delegation.
Provides a web GUI activity panel for team collaboration visibility.

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as an AgentTeams feature that enables a single natural-language request to drive a multi-agent team in DeepSeek Harness.
README states workflow includes creating a team, recruiting members, splitting tasks with dependencies, messaging/waking members, polling outputs, and reporting.
README shows a web UI panel preview and says team activity is visible in the Web GUI, confirming user-facing collaboration orchestration behavior.
